professional_work.summary: This document serves as a standard reusable NDIS care plan template designed for use by NDIS provider staff, participants, and their representatives. It outlines the necessary sections for effective support delivery, including participant identity, goals, support needs, responsibilities, risk management, and review processes.

sections.heading: Participant Identity
sections.content:
Participant Name: [PARTICIPANT_NAME] 
Date of Birth: [DATE_OF_BIRTH] 
NDIS Number: [NDIS_NUMBER] 
Contact Information: [CONTACT_INFORMATION] 
Preferred Communication Method: [PREFERENCES]

sections.heading: Support Domains and Daily Living Support Structure
sections.content:
Support Domains: 
- Daily Living Skills 
- Community Participation 
- Health and Wellbeing 
Daily Living Support Structure: 
- Personal Care: [SUPPORT_NEEDS] 
- Community Access: [SUPPORT_NEEDS] 
- Health Management: [SUPPORT_NEEDS]

sections.heading: Provider and Worker Responsibilities
sections.content: The provider is responsible for ensuring that all supports are delivered in a safe and respectful manner. Workers must adhere to the agreed support plans and communicate any changes or concerns promptly.

sections.heading: Participant, Representative and Support-Network Responsibilities
sections.content: The participant and their representative are responsible for communicating their needs and preferences. They must also engage in the planning and review processes.

sections.heading: Health, Medication, Behaviour Support and Restrictive-Practice Boundaries
sections.content: Health and medication management must be conducted by qualified professionals. Behaviour support plans must be adhered to, and any restrictive practices must be documented and justified.

sections.heading: Risk, Safety, Incident and Escalation Arrangements
sections.content: Risk management strategies must be in place, including emergency contact details and incident reporting procedures. Escalation pathways must be clearly defined.

sections.heading: Community Participation and Service-Delivery Coordination
sections.content: Community participation goals must be outlined, with clear responsibilities for coordination and support delivery.

sections.heading: Review, Updates, Consent and Sign-off Provisions
sections.content:
Review Date: [REVIEW_DATE] 
The care plan must be reviewed regularly to ensure it meets the participant's needs. Consent for the plan must be obtained from the participant and their representative. Sign-off: [SIGN_OFF]

claims.claimText: The care plan includes a section for participant identity and factual placeholders.
claims.reasoningSummary: The section clearly identifies the participant and includes placeholders for essential information.

claims.claimText: The care plan outlines participant goals, preferences, and communication needs.
claims.reasoningSummary: The goals and preferences are explicitly stated in the care plan.

claims.claimText: The care plan details support domains and daily living support structure.
claims.reasoningSummary: Support domains are clearly defined, with corresponding support needs outlined.

claims.claimText: Responsibilities of providers and workers are clearly defined in the care plan.
claims.reasoningSummary: The responsibilities of both providers and workers are articulated in the document.

claims.claimText: The care plan includes responsibilities for participants, representatives, and support networks.
claims.reasoningSummary: The roles and responsibilities of participants and their representatives are outlined.

claims.claimText: Health, medication, and behaviour support boundaries are addressed in the care plan.
claims.reasoningSummary: The care plan specifies the boundaries for health management and behaviour support.

claims.claimText: Risk, safety, incident, and escalation arrangements are included in the care plan.
claims.reasoningSummary: Risk management strategies and escalation pathways are detailed in the document.

claims.claimText: Community participation and service delivery coordination are outlined in the care plan.
claims.reasoningSummary: The care plan describes how community participation will be supported.

claims.claimText: Review, updates, consent, and sign-off provisions are included in the care plan.
claims.reasoningSummary: The care plan specifies the review date and consent requirements.
